theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  have key : forall {s1 s2}, ChoiceBisim (defs := defs) s1 s2 -> forall {t mu},
      Tr (defs := defs) s1 mu t -> exists u, Tr (defs := defs) s2 mu u /\ ChoiceBisim (defs := defs) t u := by
    intro s1 s2 hr t mu htr
    cases hr with
    | choice hb => cases htr with
      | choiceL hp => exact (hb.follow_fst hp).imp fun _ x => ⟨Tr.choiceL x.1, .bisim x.2⟩
      | choiceR hp => exact ⟨t, Tr.choiceR hp, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl t)⟩
    | bisim hb => exact (hb.follow_fst htr).imp fun _ x => ⟨x.1, .bisim x.2⟩
  have sym : forall {s1 s2}, ChoiceBisim (defs := defs) s1 s2 -> ChoiceBisim (defs := defs) s2 s1
    | _, _, .choice h => .choice h.symm
    | _, _, .bisim h => .bisim h.symm
  exact ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, fun s1 s2 hr mu =>
    ⟨fun t htr => key hr htr, fun t htr => (key (sym hr) htr).imp fun _ x => ⟨x.1, sym x.2⟩⟩⟩

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, fun _ _ k μ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  intro z hz
  cases k with
  | choice hb => cases hz with
    | choiceL hp => first
      | exact (hb.follow_fst hp).imp fun _ w => ⟨Tr.choiceL w.1, .bisim w.2⟩
      | exact (hb.follow_snd hp).imp fun _ w => ⟨Tr.choiceL w.1, .bisim w.2⟩
    | choiceR hp => exact ⟨z, Tr.choiceR hp, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl z)⟩
  | bisim hb => first
    | exact (hb.follow_fst hz).imp fun _ w => ⟨w.1, .bisim w.2⟩
    | exact (hb.follow_snd hz).imp fun _ w => ⟨w.1, .bisim w.2⟩
